title: A Nice Day at the Park
source_credit: Original WorldVoice A1 learning dialogue · text-only; no voice recording has been published.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: What a lovely day, Adam!
dialogue.translation_ar: يا له من يوم جميل يا آدم!

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes, Lina. The sky is blue.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Let's spend the afternoon in the park.
dialogue.translation_ar: لنقضِ فترة بعد الظهر في الحديقة.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Good idea. I want some fresh air.
dialogue.translation_ar: فكرة جيدة. أريد بعض الهواء النقي.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Look at the trees and flowers!

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: The red flowers are beautiful.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Do you want to sit on this bench?
dialogue.translation_ar: هل تريد الجلوس على هذا المقعد؟

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes, let's sit in the shade.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: I brought two bottles of water.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Thank you. Walking makes me thirsty.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Can you hear the birds?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes, they are singing in the trees.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: That little dog is very happy.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: He is playing with a yellow ball.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Would you like to take a picture?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes, I want a picture of the lake.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: The water looks very clean today.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: We can walk around the lake now.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Okay, but let's finish our water first.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: I hope we come back next weekend.
dialogue.translation_ar: آمل أن نعود في عطلة الأسبوع القادمة.

questions.question: What color is the dog's ball?
What does Lina want a picture of?
